views: view1: แปลนโครงหลังคาเหล็กรูปพรรณ 1:200 (บน) — T1-T7 + "โครงหลังคา ดูแบบขยาย" + "T7 - C-100x50x20x3.2mm" (split: roof_frame_plan, _view1_roof_frame_plan)
view2: แปลนคานหลังคา - โครงหลังคา 1:200 (ล่าง) — คาน ค.ส.ล. ระดับหลังคา R7-R14 + เส้นสันหลังคา/ตะเข้ (split: beam_plan, _view2_beam_plan_roof)
warnings: Upper view of S-06 = steel roof framing (hip roof) -> roof_frame_plan (structural roof framing is extracted, op04 roof_plan trap).

T1: 41 trusses — counted by detecting the vertical truss lines on the scan between the two T2 lines (3 per 4.00 bay, 1/3-bay spacing; the 13 on grid lines 3-15 included). Their positions between grids are not dimensioned, so T1 is one grouped element (count + area) instead of 41 atomic segments with invented lines.

T2 at grids 2 and 16 (hip-end girder trusses) recorded eave to eave A''-D'''' (y 12.70). T3 = the four hip trusses (diagonal, no grid span). T4-T7 = the short members of the hip ends; counts read off the dense corners (right end clearer, left end drawn symmetric) — low confidence.

Legend box: "T7 - C-100x50x20x3.2mm" (T7 is a lipped C section, element_type rafter) CONFLICTS with S-23 "T7 = C-100x50x20x2.3mm": the detail sheet wins (op01 member-spec precedence), so tw_mm = 2.3 with the plan text kept in printed_as and flagged; member sizes of T1-T6 are on the detail sheets S-22/S-23 / PT (โครงหลังคา ดูแบบขยาย). Ridge end mark 0.08 recorded in the grid master unassigned list.
